title: Nice holiday pillow covers for my home!
text: Nice holiday pillow covers for my home!. These are cute pillow covers for the holidays. They are a darker blue, matches my decor perfectly and definitely helps add to the spirit of the holidays in my home. Not the softest of material, but they fit a standard pillow perfectly and zip up easily. Quality made, too. Highly recommend.
